note: Grok 2026-10-28. Fighting game taught in small parts. Load ONE part when a kid asks. The finished example is the owner's G-Warp Smash remix. Do not paste that whole project at once.

recipes.title: Fighting game part 1: one fighter on the floor
q: load part 1 of a fighting game
make one fighter stand on the floor
start a fight game part one
steps: Make a sprite called Fighter. Paint a simple person. Paint your own person. Do not copy someone else's character.
Green flag: face right only, go to the middle of the floor, and say Ready.
This is only part 1. Next ask for part 2 (walk).

recipes.title: Fighting game part 2: walk left and right
q: load part 2 of the fighting game
add walking to my fight game
steps: Keep part 1. Add this forever loop under the green flag, after go to x y.
Right arrow faces right and steps. Left arrow faces left and steps.
Left-right rotation keeps the picture from flipping upside down.

recipes.title: Fighting game part 3: jump and fall
q: load part 3 of the fighting game
steps: Make a variable for this sprite only named y speed.
Every moment, y speed goes down by 1, then y changes by y speed.
If y is under the floor (-120), snap back to the floor and set y speed to 0.
Up arrow on the floor sets y speed to 14. That is the jump.

recipes.title: Fighting game part 4: two fighter copies
q: load part 4 of the fighting game
steps: Make a variable for this sprite only named player id.
The original hides and makes two clones.
Clone 1 stands on the left and is player 1. The next clone stands on the right and is player 2.
Each copy keeps its own player id. That is why the variable is for this sprite only.

title: Fighting game part 5: punch
q: load part 5 of the fighting game
make the fighter punch with x
steps: Make a variable for this sprite only named punching. 1 means the punch is happening.
When X is pressed and punching is 0, set punching to 1, grow a little, wait, then shrink and set punching back to 0.
The grow is a stand-in for the sword picture. Later you can switch costume instead.
